packets.transferable_primitive: Factor membership, owner binding, action progress and observation freshness into separate event channels; address slow owner, fast epoch and action-credit state by persistent owner and tenure epoch rather than slot.
packets.transformation: Localize fixed-roster episode resets to ownership epochs and replace slot-indexed state with an authoritative event ledger plus owner/epoch banks.
packets.mechanism: Atomic lifecycle barriers close leaving epochs and traces, clear slot caches, open new epochs, route action continuation by immutable action-instance ID, treat silence as typed staleness, rebuild active masks, and permit only gated slow-owner restoration on verified rejoin.
packets.learning_driver: Ordinary task return plus a separately supervised conservative slow-owner restore gate; membership semantics and fast-state clearing remain deterministic.
packets.effective_change: Adds active owner/epoch set, membership/action/observation events, multiple clocks, validity bits and state banks; inactive epochs emit no action and leave closes their live credit.
packets.information_and_credit_flow: Survivor private state persists while relational aggregates are recomputed; rewards and TD traces remain keyed to the originating epoch/action instance and never pass to a slot successor.
temporal_multi_agent_assumptions: separate representation, communication and credit masks
packets.predicted_effect: Reduce survivor disruption, wrong-owner leakage and continuing-action attribution error; improve valid-rejoin recovery only when slow owner state remains useful.
packets.simplest_alternative: EventMask-LocalReset: explicit events and active masks, local reset for every join/rejoin, no owner bank or restore gate.

packets.candidate_name: Owner-Role Binding for Identity-Tracked Entity Sets (ORBIT)
packets.transferable_primitive: Variable-cardinality equivariant entity/action structure with a persistent owner-addressed slow memory and a fresh anonymous current-roster role.
packets.transformation: Replace fixed identity alphabets and slots with external owner/epoch addressing; infer roles equivariantly from the current set and condition owner-state use on symmetry violation and utility.
packets.mechanism: A multiplicative owner-role interaction lets the ephemeral role select how slow owner information is expressed; role effects are residualized out of owner writes and a sparse identity-utility gate suppresses unnecessary specialization.
packets.learning_driver: Task return, fast relational residuals, slow owner-specific residuals and a counterfactual owner-utility gate with sparsity pressure.
packets.effective_change: Adds owner/epoch handles and owner memory while keeping pointwise entity heads permutation equivariant; owner keys are addresses rather than ordinal features.
packets.information_and_credit_flow: Current-set information uses the shared role encoder; persistent information enters only through the matched owner; owner-memory writes are owner-keyed and do not define the credit or communication graph.
temporal_multi_agent_assumptions: roles change faster than owner traits
packets.predicted_effect: Help most when stable owner traits coexist with roster-driven role swaps; collapse toward the structural baseline under exchangeability.
packets.simplest_alternative: Event-reset equivariant set policy with active masks and no persistent owner memory or learned role.

packets.transferable_primitive: Current-roster coalition marginal credit, directed causal-controllability proposals, topology-masked update influence, timestamped freshness and separate gradient/responsibility channels.
packets.transformation: Replace fixed vertices with owner-epoch tokens, condition every credit object on the authoritative active set and segment causal estimation at membership events.
packets.mechanism: Causal influence proposes directed update edges; coalition sensitivity confirms their return relevance; hysteresis activates topology edges; incident edges reset on churn while survivor edges decay and revalidate. Retrospective responsibility is fenced off from gradients.
packets.learning_driver: Team return, within-roster coalition marginal value, causal edge proposal, coalition confirmation, freshness hysteresis and separate sample-gradient protection.
packets.effective_change: Adds active owner epochs, event/freshness logs and per-edge confidence; inactive entity actions and utility flow are masked.
packets.information_and_credit_flow: Event-free data estimates controllability, active-set critics estimate coalition marginals, confirmed topology routes policy-update influence, and retrospective attribution has no path to learning.
temporal_multi_agent_assumptions: event-free spans long enough for estimation
packets.predicted_effect: Reduce post-churn update contamination and false credit edges in sparse persistent interaction graphs, at the cost of cold-start latency.
packets.simplest_alternative: Event-Masked AVGM with current active-set credit, complete update topology and reset of all credit state at every membership event.

packets.transferable_primitive: Event-conditioned attribution of reducible uncertainty coupled to selective probing, selective state refresh and an explicit exploitation budget.
packets.transformation: Replace fixed-roster novelty/restart signals with an owner/event-conditioned mixture over new-member uncertainty, incumbent drift, environmental novelty and passive noise.
packets.mechanism: Soft cause responsibilities gate probes by expected task-relevant uncertainty reduction minus exploitation cost and probe redundancy; passive noise earns no bonus and cause responsibility chooses which model state may refresh.
packets.learning_driver: Expected task-relevant reduction in reducible uncertainty under value-safety, redundancy and budget constraints, not raw surprise.
packets.effective_change: Adds owner epoch, event age, cause-specific memories, residuals, noise estimate and probe budget; bounded diagnostic actions or queries may temporarily replace the task action.
packets.information_and_credit_flow: Probe credit is held-out uncertainty reduction with a no-probe baseline; task reward remains unchanged and curiosity is not coalition credit, causal responsibility or controllability.
packets.predicted_effect: Reduce false curiosity under stochastic peers, localize adaptation and preserve exploitation, chiefly when causes are identifiable and change persists long enough to probe.
packets.simplest_alternative: A bounded exponentially decaying epsilon window after any membership event or mismatch.

packets.candidate_name: Survivor-Calibrated Owner Persistence with Event Clocks (SCOPE-Gate)
packets.transferable_primitive: Owner-scoped dual-clock memory plus a continuity certificate that compares returning-owner archive residuals with retained survivors' contemporaneous residuals.
packets.transformation: Replace global restart and unconditional rejoin restoration with per-owner/per-edge invalidation, survivor-relative rejoin testing and shard-specific import into a fresh tenure epoch.
packets.mechanism: Leave removes all incident live state and freezes only approved slow owner shards; survivors persist. Rejoin enters probation, normalizes archive residuals against survivors and age, then restores only compatible slow/context shards while rebuilding all edges and action proxies.
packets.learning_driver: Task-policy RL plus a separate continuity gate trained on owner labels, prediction/recovery loss, high false-accept cost and calibrated abstention.
packets.effective_change: Adds owner/tenure clocks, archive age, probation, shard gates and commitment receipts; lifecycle memory decisions are internal controls, not environment actions.
packets.information_and_credit_flow: Only active entities enter representations; delayed consequences attach to immutable pre-departure commitment receipts; current credit never flows to a rejoined epoch.
temporal_multi_agent_assumptions: at least one stable survivor for calibration
packets.predicted_effect: Preserve survivors better than global restart and reject stale/wrong-owner state better than unconditional restore; gain should concentrate in genuine short same-owner absences.
packets.simplest_alternative: Explicit active mask, local deletion of departing state/edges, survivor preservation and fresh initialization for every join/rejoin.

packets.transferable_primitive: Split a variable-set policy into a composition-robust shared channel and owner-addressed residual channel released only when current, owner-consistent and control-useful.
packets.transformation: Replace static composition invariance with per-edge information admissibility conditioned jointly on membership event, owner incarnation, presence spell and freshness.
packets.mechanism: An information valve trades residual control utility against shortcut sensitivity and staleness; hard constraints block inactive or epoch-mismatched residuals and force invariant-only fallback during unresolved churn.
packets.learning_driver: Task return, admissible composition-counterfactual invariance, residual utility under masking/substitution, explicit staleness supervision and anti-collapse contrast pairs.
packets.effective_change: Adds lifecycle metadata and per-entity invariant/residual tokens; the internal action is a use/suppress decision for information edges while the environment action remains unchanged.
packets.information_and_credit_flow: Owner residuals reach actors only through the valve; counterfactual masking trains utility, but information scores are not coalition credit or causal responsibility and separate topologies remain auditable.
packets.predicted_effect: Stabilize irrelevant roster changes while retaining useful specialized teammate context and preventing slot-reuse leakage.
packets.simplest_alternative: Hard epoch mask plus top-k local attention without a learned information valve.

packets.transferable_primitive: Separate representation, communication and update-credit graphs while using a slower coordination grouping only as a topology-specific prior.
packets.transformation: Project three distinct supports immediately on membership events, demote slow groups from executable edges to latent anchors and rebase coalition credit at every roster epoch.
packets.mechanism: A shared slow group state biases three topology-specific residual generators; fast active/eligibility masks override it, topology edges may disagree, joins start in probation and survivor group priors persist with revalidation.
packets.learning_driver: Policy/value representation loss, task return plus bandwidth/message-effect loss, masked utility-update loss and low-frequency grouping with hysteresis/change penalty.
packets.effective_change: Adds active-owner/epoch state, three topology matrices, eligibility masks, epoch-tagged buffers and probation; only communication adds an execution action.
packets.information_and_credit_flow: Sensor features flow on the representation graph, messages on the communication graph, and coalition-relative utility influence on the training-only credit graph; the slow anchor transmits none directly.
packets.predicted_effect: Match fast edge purge while reducing between-event topology churn and survivor recovery cost; no gain if relationships change as fast as membership.
packets.simplest_alternative: 3T-fast: three independent event-masked topology generators without slow grouping or hysteresis.

packets.candidate_name: Roster- and Owner-Stratified Subsample Mean Field (ROSTER-SMF)
packets.transferable_primitive: Fixed-k randomized population context transformed into a protected exact-identity channel plus inclusion-corrected, role-stratified exchangeable bulk summaries.
packets.transformation: Transfer from fixed anonymous uniform sampling to active owner-epoch rosters with rare-role quotas, identity memory and conditional within-role exchangeability; explicitly discard the source optimality guarantee.
packets.mechanism: Mandatory protected identities and critical roles consume part of budget k; remaining bulk is sampled by logged stratum probabilities, exact tokens are removed from summaries, violation scores promote outliers and owner/epoch memory prevents slot inheritance.
packets.learning_driver: Team return, gated sampled-view consistency for low-violation bulk, lifecycle prediction/continuity and hard coverage constraints rather than intrinsic reward.

coverage.boundary_statement: The corpus supports adjacent primitives and episode/task-level count or composition changes; no selected source demonstrates within-episode join, leave, rejoin, active-mask transitions, persistent ownership, or selective survivor-state continuity.

established_results: Variable-cardinality set/graph encoders and entity-targeted action heads can generalize across fixed scenarios with different counts.
Fixed-model cross-composition performance does not establish online population semantics.
Most identity and heterogeneity mechanisms attach learned state to a fixed slot, type, context permutation or configured agent.
Ephemeral self-vs-other structural identity can preserve permutation invariance but supplies no persistent entity owner.
Freshness, elapsed time and event type must be distinguished; repeated or absent observation alone is ambiguous.
Policy-update credit, coalition marginal credit, causal controllability, gradient compatibility and retrospective responsibility are distinct estimands.
Dynamic grouping/topology may govern representation, policy input, credit or communication; these functions are not interchangeable.
Policy-population diversity, posterior sampling and passive noise are not agent-population exploration.
Composition invariance must be tunable because useful teammate information can be lost.
Equivariance/shared priors require violation gates and identity/role residuals when exchangeability breaks.
Robustness during disturbance and recovery after a discontinuity require separate measurements.
Many-agent scaling and mean-field sampling can erase rare or persistent agents unless identity-aware coverage is added.

mechanism_primitives.content: Permutation-aware entity sets/graphs, fixed self heads plus variable entity-action heads, and cardinality-independent pooling.
Separate persistent external entity ownership from ephemeral ego, role, context and task identities.
Per-agent event clocks, freshness, ownership epochs and selective state invalidation rather than global padding/restart.
Recompute current-roster credit and keep update influence, controllability and responsibility on separate channels.
Distinguish roster novelty, incumbent policy drift, environment novelty and passive randomness; age or reset their statistics differently.
Retain useful survivor/coordination information while suppressing unstable composition shortcuts through conditional information control.
Maintain separate representation, credit and communication graphs with active-set masks, local receiver sets and slower hysteretic regrouping.
Bound context by sampled population summaries while guaranteeing rare-role/identity coverage and preserving per-identity state channels.

conflicts: MIPI-style composition invariance conflicts with CAMA/AVGM evidence that teammate information is often necessary.
Permutation/exchangeability priors conflict with identity-conditioned specialization and persistent ownership.
Long temporal retention conflicts with abrupt-churn staleness and selective reset requirements.
Soft relation weights adapt quickly; hard grouping gives structure but assumes stability and history.
Cross-agent diversity can improve exploration yet over-weighting it harms exploitation.
Centralized coaches, critics and sequence models supply information that may not exist at decentralized execution.
Autoregressive many-agent coordination scales but may encode order and does not define disappearing/reappearing positions.

cross_paper_connections.reason: Set invariance needs an explicit persistent-identity residual when entities are not truly exchangeable.
Active masks and ownership epochs determine which entity tokens and action heads are valid.
Join/leave events invalidate different novelty and belief statistics on different clocks.
Coalition and causal estimands are defined over the contemporaneous active roster.
Information control must suppress unstable composition shortcuts without deleting useful persistent-partner information.
Credit influence topology must remain distinct from communication and representation graphs.
Subsampling must not erase rare high-impact identities or their continuity state.

unresolved_innovation_opportunities.purpose: Develop an explicit membership-event and ownership-epoch lifecycle that separates join, leave, rejoin, action continuation and observation silence, with selective state preservation/reset.
Combine variable-cardinality entity/action structure with dual persistent-entity and ephemeral-role identity while retaining permutation equivariance.
Combine current-active-coalition credit, credit topology and causal influence while keeping update credit and retrospective responsibility distinct.
Create event-calibrated exploration that separates new-member uncertainty, incumbent policy drift, environmental novelty and passive randomization.
Combine per-agent event-time retention with selective staleness detection, survivor continuity and rejoin validation.
Balance composition invariance with useful teammate information using event- and ownership-conditioned information control.
Develop separate active-set representation, credit and communication topologies with fast masks and slow hysteretic grouping.
Transfer mean-field/subsample scalability to a changing roster while guaranteeing rare-role coverage and preserving identity-linked state.

portfolio.name: Factorized Ownership-Lifecycle Router
portfolio.target_problem: Unambiguous within-episode membership, action-continuation, silence, slot-rebinding and owner-rejoin semantics with selective survivor continuity.
portfolio.mechanism: Factorized event ledger and owner/epoch-addressed slow, fast and action-credit state banks with atomic event ordering and conservative restoration.
portfolio.learning_driver: Task return plus a separately supervised reset-favoring owner-state restore gate.

portfolio.name: Owner-Role Binding for Identity-Tracked Entity Sets
portfolio.target_problem: Preserve useful owner continuity and role adaptation without sacrificing entity-order equivariance.
portfolio.mechanism: Multiplicative interaction between owner-addressed slow memory and a fresh equivariant role, controlled by a sparse owner-utility gate.
portfolio.learning_driver: Task return, fast role residuals, slow owner residuals and counterfactual owner-utility regularization.

portfolio.name: Roster-Epoch Causal Credit Topology
portfolio.target_problem: Route useful update signal under churn without mixing coalition marginal credit, controllability, gradient compatibility and retrospective responsibility.
portfolio.mechanism: Causal edge proposals, coalition-sensitivity confirmation, hysteretic update topology and strict typed-estimand/no-gradient fences.
portfolio.learning_driver: Team return, within-roster marginals, causal proposal and topology confirmation with separate optimization safeguards.

portfolio.name: Event-Calibrated Four-Cause Exploration Gate
portfolio.target_problem: Distinguish reducible roster novelty, policy drift and environment novelty from passive noise while protecting exploitation.
portfolio.mechanism: Soft cause responsibilities control targeted probes, selective state refresh and an explicit task-value/probe budget.
portfolio.learning_driver: Task-relevant uncertainty reduction minus exploitation opportunity cost and multi-agent probe redundancy.

portfolio.name: Survivor-Calibrated Owner Persistence with Event Clocks
portfolio.target_problem: Validate whether and which archived owner state should cross a departure/rejoin boundary while retaining unaffected survivors.
portfolio.mechanism: Probation and survivor-relative residual calibration authorize shard-specific import into a fresh tenure epoch; incident edges always rebuild.
portfolio.learning_driver: Task RL plus separately supervised continuity, high false-accept cost and calibrated abstention.

portfolio.name: Event-Ownership Conditional Information Valve
portfolio.target_problem: Suppress composition shortcuts and stale teammate state without deleting action-relevant persistent partner information.
portfolio.mechanism: Per-edge valve balances residual control utility, composition sensitivity and lifecycle staleness with invariant-only fallback.
portfolio.learning_driver: Task return, admissible event-counterfactual invariance, residual utility and anti-collapse/staleness supervision.

portfolio.name: Event-Projected Hysteretic Three-Topology
portfolio.target_problem: Make representation, communication and credit graphs respond safely at different meanings and timescales under churn.
portfolio.mechanism: Immediate event projection on three distinct supports plus topology-specific residuals around a slower non-executable coordination anchor.
portfolio.learning_driver: Policy/value representation loss, bandwidth-aware communication loss, masked credit loss and hysteretic grouping stability.

portfolio.name: Roster- and Owner-Stratified Subsample Mean Field
portfolio.target_problem: Bound context cost while retaining rare/high-impact identities, survivor state and conditional exchangeability in a changing roster.
portfolio.mechanism: Protected exact-identity channel plus role-stratified sampled bulk summaries with logged inclusion, violation-gated pooling and owner-epoch memory.
portfolio.learning_driver: Team return, low-violation sampled-view consistency, lifecycle continuity and hard rare-role coverage constraints.

portfolio.name: FOLR-Core
portfolio.target_problem: Guarantee correct join, leave, replacement, rejoin, slot reuse, survivor continuity and delayed-credit routing without assuming that state is portable across ownership epochs.
portfolio.mechanism: An idempotent authoritative lifecycle ledger opens fresh owner epochs, rejects stale observations, rebuilds typed masks, preserves uninterrupted survivor-private state and routes late reward by immutable action instance.
portfolio.learning_driver: No learned lifecycle driver; ordinary task return trains the unchanged base learner while lifecycle transitions remain deterministic.

portfolio.name: FOLR-Core plus SCOPE-1S Restoration Interface
portfolio.target_problem: Test whether exactly one authenticated slow owner shard can improve rejoin recovery after deterministic lifecycle correctness is already satisfied.
portfolio.mechanism: FOLR-Core always opens a fresh epoch; one total no-parameter rule may import a single verified quarantined owner-local slow shard, abstain once when exactly one frozen drift screen passes, or FreshReset. Every fast, relational, optimizer, trace and credit state remains nonportable.
portfolio.learning_driver: No release learner: the frozen two-screen rule is deterministic; ordinary task return evaluates restoration while remaining separate from action credit and lifecycle invariants.

portfolio.name: ORBIT-Lite
portfolio.target_problem: Identify genuine nonadditive utility between authenticated persistent owner state and a current anonymous role under variable roster and held-out partners.
portfolio.mechanism: One gain-free normalized rank-k owner-role product with no owner main effect, a near-zero sparse gate, role-residualized writes and a bounded authenticated owner/epoch cache.
portfolio.learning_driver: Ordinary task return with a near-zero sparse owner residual; exploration, critic, communication and credit topology are fixed across controls.

portfolio.name: RECCT-Lite
portfolio.target_problem: Route current-roster cross-agent update signal under churn without conflating causal response, return relevance, update credit and retrospective responsibility.
portfolio.mechanism: Supported one-step proposals and disjoint within-epoch semantic leave-one-out confirmation create a detached binary hysteretic credit mask; responsibility exits through a reporting-only sink.
portfolio.learning_driver: Team return and signed current-roster update credit; safe probes have explicit cost and do not become rewards or responsibility labels.

portfolio.name: Event-Calibrated Reducibility Gate R1
portfolio.target_problem: Decide whether one native safe probe is worth its exploitation cost after an execution-visible event without inferring hidden physical causes.
portfolio.mechanism: A cross-fitted randomized probe/no-probe treatment estimate drives a three-way probe, operationally-aleatoric or abstain decision with a one-probe event cap.
portfolio.learning_driver: Positive fixed-horizon net task-value improvement after explicit probe cost, never surprise or semantic cause accuracy.

portfolio.name: SCOPE-1S
portfolio.target_problem: Selectively reuse one portable owner-specific state object after rejoin without disturbing survivors, importing stale state or receiving free probation exposure.
portfolio.mechanism: One immutable owner-local shard remains in strict quarantine until absolute and survivor-relative drift plus cross-fitted net recovery value authorize import; reset and finite priced abstention are explicit.
portfolio.learning_driver: Cost-sensitive recovery regret from randomized propensity-bearing receipts; drift scores provide safety evidence rather than reward labels.

portfolio.name: EOCIV-Lite
portfolio.target_problem: Suppress stale, owner-mismatched or conditionally useless teammate payloads without deleting eligible information essential for coordination.
portfolio.mechanism: A universal set actor receives payloads only after a hard lifecycle predicate and one pre-reveal scalar edge valve trained by randomized physically valid reveal/mask net utility.
portfolio.learning_driver: Team return for the common backbone and positive out-of-fold marginal reveal utility for the valve, kept separate from coalition credit.

portfolio.name: Local-Lineage Typed 3T-Fast
portfolio.target_problem: Keep representation inclusion, physical communication and update-credit routing operationally distinct under churn with no centralized-teacher lineage.
portfolio.mechanism: Three independent local-only fast gates are projected through topology-specific activity and owner-epoch masks before their respective operations; no loss forces support disagreement.
portfolio.learning_driver: Operator-specific task/value, bandwidth and isolated update-quality objectives; lifecycle masks are hard contracts.

portfolio.name: L3T-Fast plus Violation-Gated Anchor
portfolio.target_problem: Test whether a slow local relational prior predicts future typed-edge utility beyond generic persistence of fast edge logits.
portfolio.mechanism: A bounded same-epoch local pair-history prior may bias typed fast logits only behind a past-only violation gate; closing the gate recovers the fast core exactly.
portfolio.learning_driver: The core objectives plus past-only local stability and prediction calibration, compared to a state-, cadence- and exposure-matched generic-inertia branch.

portfolio.name: Bounded-Input Frozen-Strata ROSTER-SMF
portfolio.target_problem: Bound one focal network's entity-context input while retaining a predeclared rare decisive entity, preserving unsampled target reachability and preventing slot-state inheritance.
portfolio.mechanism: A frozen sampler divides k slots into capped protected exact lanes and positive-inclusion stratified bulk lanes, logs a declared linear HT estimand, enumerates legal targets separately and uses bounded owner-epoch memory.
portfolio.learning_driver: Ordinary team return only; sampling is passive exposure and inclusion weights correct only the declared linear bulk statistic.
